themes.label: Support Response Time
themes.describe: Complaints regarding slow, unhelpful, or inaccessible customer support channels.

quotes.text: We have used Stamped for nearly seven years and, until recently, had very few problems. …
Non existent customer service. You guys charge $23 for customers to even use your app, and you couldn't hire a few cs agent??
Super buggy app. I couldn't even choose a paid plan and customer service does not reply in a day. It's a paid app and no service. …

gists: Review requests stopped sending; support had to manually push them.
Poor customer service and unexpected charges for basic use.
App is buggy; customer service is unresponsive and unhelpful.
App is buggy, slow, and support won't export reviews to CSV.
Customer service is slow; integration issues unresolved via email.
Widgets load slowly; support has not responded to issues.

brief.headline: Support Response Time: raised mostly in happy reviews
brief.happening: Of the 21 reviews in the last 12 months that raise this, 15 are 4–5 stars and 5 are 1–2 stars: it comes up mostly as a request or a side note from people who like the app. The evidence below shows the unhappy ones.
brief.where_to_look: The customer support ticketing and email communication flow.
brief.action: Review recent support ticket response logs for patterns in delayed resolutions.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear about your experience with our service and pricing. We value your feedback regarding our support availability and will share this with our team. If you would like to discuss your account further, please reach out to our support team.

themes.label: Billing & Pricing
themes.describe: Users complain about unexpected charges, forced upgrades, or confusing billing practices.

quotes.text: Charged after uninstalling the app -- I uninstalled Stamped on October 5, 2026, after migrating to Judge.me, but Stamped later charged my bank card directly. …
Hi team,I’m writing to you because we recently had to uninstall your app, and I really wanted to share why. …
Non existent customer service. You guys charge $23 for customers to even use your app, and you couldn't hire a few cs agent??

gists: Charged after uninstalling; billing cancellation was unclear.
Review requests stopped sending; charged despite uninstalling app.
Poor customer service and unexpected charges for basic use.
App is expensive and difficult to use; recommends alternative.

brief.headline: Increase in billing and unexpected charge complaints
brief.happening: Users report being charged after uninstalling the app and finding the cancellation process unclear. There are also concerns regarding unexpected costs for basic usage and difficulty accessing customer service.
brief.where_to_look: The subscription cancellation flow and the automated billing triggers following app uninstallation.
brief.action: Review the clarity of the cancellation confirmation messages in the billing dashboard.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear about this experience with your recent charges. We want to ensure our billing process is transparent and easy to manage. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into your account details and help resolve this for you.

themes.label: App Bugs & Glitches
themes.describe: Reports of core functionality failing, reviews not displaying, or the app being generally buggy.

quotes.text: Hi team,I’m writing to you because we recently had to uninstall your app, and I really wanted to share why. …
Super buggy app. I couldn't even choose a paid plan and customer service does not reply in a day. It's a paid app and no service. …
This app is buggy, slow and I cannot get any help from customer support to export all my reviews to a .csv file. …

gists: Review requests stopped sending; charged despite uninstalling app.
App is buggy; customer service is unresponsive and unhelpful.
App is buggy, slow, and support won't export reviews to CSV.

brief.headline: Decrease in reports of app bugs and glitches
brief.happening: A small number of recent reviews report core functionality failures, such as review requests not sending and difficulties exporting data. These 3 reviews from the last 12 months all carry 1-2 star ratings.
brief.where_to_look: The review request delivery system and the CSV export functionality.
brief.action: Review the recent logs for failed review request triggers and export requests.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear about your experience with the uninstallation process and the issues with your review requests. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into your account details and help resolve this.

themes.label: Slowness & Performance
themes.describe: Concerns that the app significantly slows down the website loading time or backend operations.

quotes.text: We have been using this app for over 10 years on the Business plan at $149 per month. …

gists: App does not work and is extremely slow.
Widgets load slowly; support has not responded to issues.

brief.headline: Increasing reports of app slowness and performance issues
brief.happening: A small minority of recent reviews, representing 5% of all recent feedback, report that the app is extremely slow and widgets load with significant delays. These 2 reviews from the last 12 months both carry 1-2 star ratings, with 67% of these users reporting something broken.
brief.where_to_look: The widget loading sequence on the storefront.
brief.action: Review recent performance metrics related to widget rendering speeds.
brief.reply: Thank you for being a loyal customer for over 10 years. We are sorry to hear about the performance issues you are experiencing with the app. Please contact our support team so we can look into this for you.

themes.label: Feature Failure
themes.describe: Specific complaints that core features (like importing, sending requests, or displaying stars) are not working.

quotes.text: We have used Stamped for nearly seven years and, until recently, had very few problems. …
My 5 stars are showing up as question marks.

gists: Review requests stopped sending; support had to manually push them.
Five-star ratings are incorrectly displaying as question marks.

brief.headline: Intermittent core feature failures in review requests and display
brief.happening: A minority of users report that review requests have stopped sending automatically and five-star ratings are displaying as question marks. This trend is steady compared with the previous period.
brief.where_to_look: The automated review request delivery flow and the star rating rendering logic.
brief.action: Review the recent logs for failed request triggers and star icon rendering errors.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear about the display issue with your star ratings. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into this specific instance for you.

themes.label: Backend Complexity

quotes.text: this app is expensive and is cumbersome, not easy to use. would recommend another app

gists: App is expensive and difficult to use; recommends alternative.

themes.label: Integration Problems
themes.describe: Difficulties connecting the app with other platforms or Shopify features.

quotes.text: The customer service on this app is super slow and outdated. I've tried to contact them to resolve an integration issue for days, and it's not going anywhere because they reply via email …

gists: Customer service is slow; integration issues unresolved via email.

been accumulating and showing reviews on my website for over a year and now they from one day to another prevent ALL OF MY REVIEWS from showing on my site because they want me to upgrade …
They changed their free plan after collecting reviews for over 4 years so that you can no longer show the reviews without going to at least the $19/month plan. …

gists: Free plan changed to paid; collected reviews were removed.
Reviews disappear upon forced upgrade to paid plan.
Reviews are now inaccessible without paying a higher fee.
